facts.fact: Pangea (ex-Nikuv), contracted in 2012 to design, supply and implement Lesotho's civil registration and national ID systems, held maintenance and support agreements with the Ministry of Home Affairs, the latest of September 2024 at US$283,290 a month, ended 30 December 2024 with a new company to take over, per the Lesotho Times.
